title: Recording: Death Of Samantha, Is Winter Here To Stay?, I Have A Woman Inside My Soul by Yoko Ono | 1972
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono

Two songs on Yoko Ono‘s third album Approximately Infinite Universe were recorded on 9 November 1972, with John Lennon co-producing.

The recording of ‘Death Of Samantha’ and ‘Is Winter Here To Stay?’ was completed in this session. ‘Death Of Samantha’ was first mixed on 19 November, with the final mix created on 25 November. ‘Is Winter Here To Stay?’ was mixed on 27 November.

The final recording made on this day was ‘I Have A Woman Inside My Soul’. Mick Jagger from The Rolling Stones was present at the studio during this session.

Page last updated: 18 March 2026
